response.text: Several findings so far: a duplicate invoice (602/801), an account 5900 that is inactive or missing from the chart, and two invoices whose journal totals don't match the invoice amount. Let me look at these more closely.

arguments.sql: SELECT i."INV_ID", i."VEND_CD", i."INV_NO", i."INV_DT", i."INV_AMT", i."STAT_CD", i."JRNL_NO" FROM public."APINVH" i WHERE i."INV_ID" IN (602,801,671,802)
SELECT l."JRNL_NO", l."LN_SEQ", l."ACCT_CD", l."DR_AMT", l."CR_AMT" FROM public."GLJRNL" l WHERE TRIM(l."ACCT_CD")='5900' OR l."JRNL_NO" IN (2114,2491)
